title: Bernoulli Probability Mass Function & Moments
description:
Evaluate a Bernoulli distribution at each value in x:

$$
P(X=x) = \begin{cases}1-p, & x=0 \\ p, & x=1\end{cases}
$$

Its mean and variance are:

$$
\mu = p
$$

$$
\sigma^2 = p(1-p)
$$

Here, $p$ is the success probability. Return a dictionary containing pmf as a NumPy array and mean and variance as Python floats.
seoDescription: Compute the Bernoulli probability mass function, expected value, and variance for a valid success probability.

solution:
### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Evaluates the PMF $p^x (1-p)^{1-x}$ for binary outcomes with expected value $p$ and variance $p(1-p)$.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def bernoulli_pmf_and_moments(x: list, p: float) -> dict:
    pmf = [float(p if val == 1 else (1.0 - p if val == 0 else 0.0)) for val in x]
    return {
        "pmf": pmf,
        "mean": float(p),
        "variance": float(round(p * (1.0 - p), 6))
    }
```

- **Time Complexity:** $\mathcal{O}(N)$
- **Space Complexity:** $\mathcal{O}(N)$
